cases.selection-coding-flatten:
def flatten_one(rows):
    return [item for row in rows for item in row]
cases.selection-coding-totals:
def running_totals(values):
    total=0
    result=[]
    for value in values:
        total += value
        result.append(total)
    return result
cases.selection-coding-headers:
def normalize_headers(headers):
    return [header.strip().lower() for header in headers]
